capabilities: Add web links and files of any type to the left ribbon
Group items into nested folders via drag and drop
Open items in new tabs, splits, or windows with modifier clicks
Set flat monochrome icons from Lucide, brand logos, an online SVG search, or custom .svg files
Reorder items and add separators by dragging
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later. Can be installed via BRAT for versions not yet in the community directory. No telemetry; network requests only for the optional icon search and site logo lookup.
problem: Frequent links and files live in different places (browser, file explorer, core bookmarks panel), so reaching them takes several clicks instead of one.

relations.evidence: Tab behavior and browser rendering are inherited from the vault: Surfing → Web viewer → system browser

summary: Bookmark bar for the left ribbon that opens web links and any file type, organized in nested folders with drag and drop and custom icons.
